metadata.descriptor: An Explainable Multi-Model Cricket Intelligence System for Pressure Performance & Player Reliability.

top_10_batters.selection_rationale: Rank 1: #1 Multi-Format Finisher. Only player in tournament history to exceed 170.0 shrunk strike rate (M=45) in both IPL (170.7) and Senior T20Is (171.1) across 510 combined pressure balls with low dot balls (30.8% IPL, 33.0% T20I). Selection judgement call vs SKY driven by multi-format finishing versatility.
top_10_batters.main_strengths: Demonstrates elite multi-format pressure finishing: IPL 334 balls (175.4 raw SR, 170.7 M45, +24.9 RAE, 73.1% match pass rate) and T20I 176 balls (184.7 raw SR, 171.1 M45, +52.1 RAE, 90.0% match pass rate). Combined 510 pressure balls across 47 matches.
top_10_batters.main_weaknesses: Higher match-to-match variance in international cricket (T20I match std 60.1) compared to domestic franchise baseline (IPL std 79.9).
top_10_batters.selection_risks: Low risk; classified as ROBUST_ANCHOR across 47 combined matches (510 pressure balls).

top_10_batters.selection_rationale: Rank 2: #1 Middle Crisis Anchor. Tournament volume benchmark (832 combined balls across 60 matches), highest match pass rate (83.9% across 31 evaluated IPL matches), and +18.1 IPL RAE. Indistinguishable on bootstrap from Tim David (CI [-18.1, 40.9]) and Jaiswal (CI [-36.6, 15.3]); positioned at #2 as premier crisis stabilizer.
top_10_batters.main_strengths: Highest pressure sample volume in tournament (IPL 579 balls, T20I 253 balls, 832 combined across 60 matches). High consistency (IPL SR 163.7, +18.1 RAE, 83.9% match pass rate) and low dot-ball rate (30.4% IPL dots, 24.0% boundary rate).
top_10_batters.main_weaknesses: Slightly lower boundary percentage in T20I cricket (23.3%) relative to IPL (24.0%), and higher T20I dot rate (40.3%).
top_10_batters.selection_risks: Minimal selection risk; benchmark ROBUST_ANCHOR with proven multi-season consistency.

top_10_batters.selection_rationale: Rank 3: Premier IPL Top-Order Anchor. Elite Powerplay aggression (174.8 IPL raw SR, +30.6 RAE, 32.0% boundary rate across 266 IPL pressure balls). Positioned ahead of Pooran via superior boundary production and Powerplay phase leverage; indistinguishable on bootstrap from SKY and Pooran.
top_10_batters.main_strengths: Premier IPL top-order pressure anchor: 266 balls across 38 matches, 174.8 raw SR, +30.6 RAE, 32.0% boundary rate, and high match pass rate (79.3%).
top_10_batters.main_weaknesses: Higher dot-ball rate in early powerplay pressure (42.1% IPL dots). Limited senior T20I pressure exposure (12 balls).
top_10_batters.selection_risks: Low risk; proven franchise anchor resilient to heavy shrinkage (shrunk M=90 SR is 165.2).

top_10_batters.selection_rationale: Rank 4: Elite Left-Hand Middle Anchor. 717 combined pressure balls across 61 matches, 166.6 IPL raw SR, +18.8 RAE, and dual-format versatility. Positioned ahead of Dinesh Karthik due to much broader phase adaptability (Middle and Death) vs Karthik's narrow death specialization.
top_10_batters.main_strengths: High volume left-handed middle-order anchor: 491 IPL balls (166.6 SR, +18.8 RAE, 61.8% pass rate) and 226 T20I balls. Balanced multi-phase acceleration across middle and death phases.
top_10_batters.main_weaknesses: International pressure strike rate drops to 142.5 in T20Is (+7.6 RAE) with 42.9% dot-ball rate.
top_10_batters.selection_risks: Low risk; multi-season ROBUST_ANCHOR with 717 combined pressure balls across 61 matches.

top_10_batters.selection_rationale: Rank 5: Acute Death Crisis Finisher. Highest context-adjusted efficiency among established IPL batters (+39.3 RAE, 184.3 raw SR, 78.9% match pass rate over 216 IPL balls). Narrow phase profile (82.4% death balls) places him behind complete middle-order anchors.
top_10_batters.main_strengths: Exceptional crisis execution: 216 IPL balls across 23 matches, 184.3 raw SR, +39.3 RAE, 26.4% boundary rate, and 26.9% dot-ball rate (78.9% match pass rate).
top_10_batters.main_weaknesses: Confined almost exclusively to death-overs phase (82.4% death balls).
top_10_batters.selection_risks: Moderate risk; phase-specialized finisher requiring protected entry point.

top_10_batters.selection_rationale: Rank 6: High-Volume Multi-Format Opener. 510 combined pressure balls across 64 matches, 165.2 IPL SR (+21.1 RAE) and 164.3 T20I SR (+35.2 RAE). Positioned ahead of Salt based on massive 353-ball IPL pressure sample; indistinguishable on bootstrap from Karthik and Salt.
top_10_batters.main_strengths: High-volume multi-format attacking weapon: IPL 353 balls (165.2 SR, +21.1 RAE, 65.5% pass rate) and T20I 157 balls (164.3 SR, +35.2 RAE, 68.8% pass rate). Combined 510 pressure balls across 64 matches.
top_10_batters.main_weaknesses: Higher dot-ball rate (37.1% IPL, 37.6% T20I) reflecting aggressive boundary-seeking approach.
top_10_batters.selection_risks: Low risk; verified ROBUST_ANCHOR with proven cross-format attacking reliability.

top_10_batters.selection_rationale: Rank 7: Modern International Attacking Opener. Outstanding international pressure production (178.8 T20I SR, +42.8 RAE) paired with 162.8 IPL SR (+20.0 RAE). Positioned ahead of Klaasen via superior top-order strike acceleration; indistinguishable on bootstrap.
top_10_batters.main_strengths: Modern international power attacking anchor: T20I 170 balls (178.8 SR, +42.8 RAE, 25.3% boundaries, 71.4% pass rate); IPL 113 balls (162.8 SR, +20.0 RAE, 77.8% pass rate). Combined 283 balls across 36 matches.
top_10_batters.main_weaknesses: Dot-ball percentage of 38.1% in IPL pressure deliveries and 30.6% in T20I.
top_10_batters.selection_risks: Low risk; strict-tier ROBUST_ANCHOR with high multi-competition consistency.

top_10_batters.selection_rationale: Rank 8: Middle-Overs Spin Enforcer. 535 combined pressure balls, +23.9 IPL RAE, and 25.9% dot-ball rate (lowest dot rate among top-order/middle anchors). Positioned at #8 due to more conservative international scoring (140.5 T20I SR across 126 balls); indistinguishable on bootstrap from Salt and Maxwell.
top_10_batters.main_strengths: High-volume middle-order power anchor: 409 IPL balls (161.1 SR, +23.9 RAE, 25.9% dots) and 126 T20I balls. High match pass rate (78.3%) across 29 IPL matches.
top_10_batters.main_weaknesses: T20I pressure strike rate is more conservative (140.5 SR across 126 balls).
top_10_batters.selection_risks: Low risk; classified as ROBUST_ANCHOR whose value is amplified in high-difficulty middle overs.

top_10_batters.selection_rationale: Rank 9: Multi-Format Middle Accelerator. 321 combined pressure balls, 172.9 IPL raw SR (+30.9 RAE) and 166.0 T20I SR (+30.2 RAE). Positioned at #9 behind Klaasen due to higher match variance (74.6 IPL std); bootstrap comparison vs Sooryavanshi shows statistical separation (CI [-103.6, -7.9]).
top_10_batters.main_strengths: Proven multi-format middle-order accelerator: IPL 177 balls (172.9 SR, +30.9 RAE, 71.4% pass rate) and T20I 144 balls (166.0 SR, +30.2 RAE, 73.3% pass rate). Combined 321 balls across 33 matches.
top_10_batters.main_weaknesses: Match-to-match standard deviation of 74.6 SR points in IPL.
top_10_batters.selection_risks: Moderate risk; high variance strike profile balanced by proven dual-format volume.

top_10_batters.selection_rationale: Rank 10: Breakout High-Upside Discovery Talent. Highest raw pressure strike rate in tournament history (231.6 raw SR, 195.8 shrunk M45, +86.8 RAE, 43.4% boundary rate over 76 IPL balls). Selected over non-selected alternatives as high-ceiling discovery upside, with explicit uncertainty disclosure regarding 76-ball sample.
top_10_batters.main_strengths: Breakout high-upside discovery talent: 76 IPL balls across 12 matches, 231.6 raw SR, +86.8 RAE, 43.4% boundary ball rate. Shrunk M=45 SR remains elite at 195.8.
top_10_batters.main_weaknesses: Sample size is limited to 76 IPL balls (12 matches); 43.4% dot-ball rate reflects all-or-nothing boundary hitting.
top_10_batters.selection_risks: Moderate-to-high risk; SHRINKAGE_SENSITIVE candidate preserved as premier high-ceiling discovery option.

top_10_bowlers.selection_rationale: Rank 1: #1 Middle-Overs Run Suppression Benchmark. Lowest economy in tournament history (6.70 raw economy, 7.28 M45, -2.79 RCAE across 317 IPL pressure balls) with an 89.5% match pass rate (34/38 matches <=9.0 econ or >=1 wkt). Positioned at #1 as the premier defensive squeeze asset; bootstrap vs Bumrah spans zero (CI [-2.34, 0.31]), making this a tactical judgement call prioritizing unmatched run choke.
top_10_bowlers.main_strengths: Tournament benchmark for middle-overs run suppression: 317 IPL pressure balls across 41 matches, 6.70 economy, -2.79 RCAE, 38.8% dot balls, 10.4% boundary concession, 0.36 wickets per over, and 89.5% match pass rate. Lowest economy in database.
top_10_bowlers.main_weaknesses: Minimal death-overs exposure (less than 15% death deliveries); almost exclusively specialized in middle phase.
top_10_bowlers.selection_risks: Low risk for middle overs; tactical risk if forced into death-overs situations without pace support.

top_10_bowlers.selection_rationale: Rank 2: #1 All-Phases Pressure Anchor. Premier pace volume (391 IPL balls, 103 T20I balls, 494 combined across 53 matches), 7.84 IPL Economy (-2.33 RCAE) with 32.7% dot-ball rate while bowling tournament's toughest death overs. Indistinguishable on bootstrap from Narine (CI [-2.34, 0.31]) and Pathirana (CI [-2.24, 0.79]); placed at #2 due to complete phase versatility.
top_10_bowlers.main_strengths: Premier all-phases pressure anchor: 391 IPL balls across 41 matches, 7.84 economy, -2.33 RCAE, 32.7% dot balls, 71.8% match pass rate. Combined 494 balls across 53 matches. Handles tournament's most demanding death overs.
top_10_bowlers.main_weaknesses: Higher economy in small international T20I sample (10.72 over 103 balls).
top_10_bowlers.selection_risks: Minimal selection risk; gold-standard ROBUST_ANCHOR with tournament-proven defensive execution.

top_10_bowlers.selection_rationale: Rank 3: #1 Death Phase Wicket Threat. 316 death-phase pressure balls yielding 31 wickets (0.589 wkts/over, a wicket every 10.2 balls) at 8.62 death economy; overall IPL pressure 0.49 wkts/over, 9.18 economy (-1.58 RCAE). Positioned ahead of Nawaz due to proven IPL death execution; indistinguishable on bootstrap from Bumrah and Nawaz.
top_10_bowlers.main_strengths: Premier death-phase wicket-taking weapon: 317 IPL balls across 31 matches, 0.49 wickets per over, 33.8% dot balls, negative RCAE (-1.58), 75.0% match pass rate. Specifically in death overs across competitions: 316 balls, 31 wickets (0.589 wkts/over), 8.62 death economy.
top_10_bowlers.main_weaknesses: Overall economy rate of 9.18 in IPL pressure, reflecting severe high-leverage death deployment.
top_10_bowlers.selection_risks: Low-to-moderate risk; ROBUST_ANCHOR death specialist whose run suppression is superior to phase expectations.

top_10_bowlers.selection_rationale: Rank 4: Premier International Spin Restrictor. Elite international pressure metrics (80 T20I balls, 6.83 economy, -1.62 RCAE, 0.75 wkts/over, 36.2% dots, 80.0% pass rate). Positioned at #4 ahead of Malinga via superior economy and run suppression; explicit uncertainty disclosure that he has 0 IPL match exposure in the dataset.
top_10_bowlers.main_strengths: Premier international left-arm spin restrictor: 80 T20I balls across 15 matches, 6.83 economy, -1.62 RCAE, 0.75 wickets per over, 36.2% dot balls, 80.0% match pass rate.
top_10_bowlers.main_weaknesses: No IPL match exposure in dataset; international sample size is moderate (80 balls).
top_10_bowlers.selection_risks: Moderate risk; BALANCED tier international candidate requiring adaptation to Indian pitch conditions.

top_10_bowlers.selection_rationale: Rank 5: Elite Dual-Format Wicket Pacer. 255 combined pressure balls across 26 matches, 0.60 IPL wickets per over at 8.42 economy (-1.34 RCAE) and 42.7% dot-ball rate. Positioned ahead of Noor Ahmad based on superior wicket frequency (0.60 vs 0.42 wkts/over); indistinguishable on bootstrap from Nawaz and Noor Ahmad.
top_10_bowlers.main_strengths: Elite strike bowling impact: 171 IPL balls across 18 matches, 8.42 economy, -1.34 RCAE, 0.60 wickets per over, 42.7% dot balls, 73.3% match pass rate. T20I 84 balls (9.21 economy, 0.43 wkts/over, 75.0% pass rate). Combined 255 pressure balls.
top_10_bowlers.selection_risks: Low risk; multi-competition ROBUST_ANCHOR with proven high-wicket penetration.

top_10_bowlers.selection_rationale: Rank 6: Middle-Overs Wrist Spin Control. 228 IPL pressure balls across 28 matches, 8.61 economy (-0.81 RCAE, 0.42 wkts/over, 37.7% dots, 72.0% pass rate). Positioned ahead of Ashwin via superior wicket strike potency (0.42 vs 0.31 wkts/over); indistinguishable on bootstrap from Malinga and Ashwin.
top_10_bowlers.main_strengths: Middle-overs wrist-spin containment: 228 IPL balls across 28 matches, 8.61 economy, -0.81 RCAE, 0.42 wickets per over, 37.7% dot balls, 72.0% match pass rate. Combined 279 balls across 37 matches.
top_10_bowlers.main_weaknesses: T20I economy rises to 10.71 over 51 balls.
top_10_bowlers.selection_risks: Low risk; proven IPL ROBUST_ANCHOR with strong middle-phase control.

top_10_bowlers.selection_rationale: Rank 7: Tactical Finger Spin Anchor. 247 combined pressure balls across 36 matches, 8.79 IPL economy (-0.66 RCAE, 80.0% pass rate) and 7.69 T20I economy (100% pass rate). Positioned ahead of Hasaranga based on lower boundary concession (14.9% vs 17.2%) and defensive reliability; indistinguishable on bootstrap.
top_10_bowlers.main_strengths: Tactical finger-spin anchor: 215 IPL balls across 32 matches, 8.79 economy, -0.66 RCAE, 0.31 wickets per over, 80.0% match pass rate; T20I 32 balls (7.69 economy, 100% match pass rate). Combined 247 balls across 36 matches.
top_10_bowlers.main_weaknesses: Lower dot-ball rate (27.0% IPL) and lower raw strike rate compared to wrist spinners.
top_10_bowlers.selection_risks: Low risk; experienced franchise ROBUST_ANCHOR with low boundary concession (14.9%).

top_10_bowlers.phase_suitability: Middle Phase Strike Weapon (Overs 7-15) & Pinch Death
top_10_bowlers.selection_rationale: Rank 8: Multi-Format Strike Threat. Tournament-leading raw wicket frequency in IPL (0.64 wkts/over across 151 balls) and consistent international production (175 T20I balls, 8.50 economy, -0.29 RCAE, 0.51 wkts/over). Placed at #8 due to higher boundary concession (17.2%); indistinguishable on bootstrap from Ashwin and Sears.
top_10_bowlers.main_strengths: Multi-format wrist-spin wicket weapon: IPL 151 balls (8.94 economy, 0.64 wkts/over, -0.23 RCAE, 70.0% pass rate); T20I 175 balls (8.50 economy, 0.51 wkts/over, -0.29 RCAE, 66.7% pass rate). Combined 326 balls across 53 matches.
top_10_bowlers.main_weaknesses: Boundary concession rate of 17.2% in IPL.
top_10_bowlers.selection_risks: Low risk; dual-format ROBUST_ANCHOR with proven wicket threat across middle overs.

top_10_bowlers.selection_rationale: Rank 9: International High-Pace Containment. 101 T20I pressure balls across 14 matches, 7.96 economy (-1.41 RCAE, 0.59 wkts/over, 39.6% dots, 70.0% pass rate). Positioned at #9; bootstrap comparison vs Mayank Yadav shows statistical separation in T20Is (CI [-7.10, -0.23]); explicit disclosure of 0 IPL balls.
top_10_bowlers.main_strengths: High-pace international containment: 101 T20I balls across 14 matches, 7.96 economy, -1.41 RCAE, 0.59 wickets per over, 39.6% dot balls, 70.0% match pass rate.
top_10_bowlers.main_weaknesses: No IPL match experience in dataset; international sample size is moderate (101 balls).
top_10_bowlers.selection_risks: Moderate risk; strict-tier ROBUST_ANCHOR in T20I requiring franchise transition validation.

top_10_bowlers.selection_rationale: Rank 10: Breakout High-Ceiling Discovery Pacer. Elite raw IPL run suppression and dot-ball generation (43 IPL balls, 7.95 economy, -2.37 RCAE, 0.56 wkts/over, 51.2% dot-ball rate — highest in tournament). Selected as high-upside pace discovery over non-selected alternatives, with honest uncertainty disclosure regarding 43-ball IPL sample.
top_10_bowlers.main_strengths: Breakout high-upside pace discovery candidate: 43 IPL balls across 5 matches, 7.95 economy, -2.37 RCAE, 0.56 wickets per over, 51.2% dot-ball rate (highest dot rate in cohort, 100% match pass rate). Combined 134 balls across 13 matches.
top_10_bowlers.main_weaknesses: Limited sample size (43 balls across 5 matches); high economy in small T20I sample (11.67 across 91 balls).
top_10_bowlers.selection_risks: Moderate-to-high risk; DISCOVERY_UPSIDE candidate with small sample exposure requiring anchor hedging.

key_discoveries.headline: Tim David (#1 Batter) — Unmatched Dual-Format Pressure Finisher
key_discoveries.detail: Only qualified batter in database exceeding 170.0 shrunk strike rate (M=45) in both IPL (170.7) and Senior T20Is (171.1). Sustains 23.7% IPL boundary rate and +24.9 Context RAE.

key_discoveries.headline: Sunil Narine (#1 Bowler) — Benchmark Middle-Overs Defensive Squeeze
key_discoveries.detail: Conceded tournament-lowest 6.70 raw economy, -3.07 All-Runs RCAE, and -2.79 Legal-Ball RCAE across 317 legal IPL pressure deliveries. 89.5% match pass rate across 38 evaluated matches (34/38).

key_discoveries.headline: Matheesha Pathirana (#3 Bowler) — #1 Seamer Death Wicket Strike Rate
key_discoveries.detail: Across 316 combined death-phase pressure deliveries, captured 31 wickets at 8.62 runs/over (0.589 wkts/over / 1 wicket every 10.2 balls), leading all specialist death seamers.

key_discoveries.headline: Yashasvi Jaiswal (#3 Batter) — Elite Powerplay Boundary Production
key_discoveries.detail: Recorded 31.5% boundary rate (69 boundaries in 219 balls) in IPL Powerplay pressure, ranking #1 among batters with >= 200 Powerplay pressure balls.

key_discoveries.headline: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi (#10 Batter) — High-Ceiling Boundary Discovery
key_discoveries.detail: Highest raw strike rate (231.6) and #1 shrunk M=45 SR (195.8) among all 141 batters with >= 50 pressure balls. Polar 43.4% boundary and 43.4% dot-ball distribution in 76 balls.

key_discoveries.headline: Mayank Yadav (#10 Bowler) — #1 Dot-Ball Rate in Qualifying Cohort
key_discoveries.detail: Produced 46.5% dot-ball rate (20 dots in 43 legal deliveries), ranking #1 among all 125 bowlers with >= 40 IPL pressure balls, with 7.95 raw economy.
